name: Cinematic Human Behavior World v2

creativeTranslation.principle: prompt observable evidence, not abstract psychology
creativeTranslation.flowAgentRole: production executor, not autonomous art director

character.head: simple round or slightly oval head
character.face: minimal expressive eyes, mouth and optional eyebrows
character.torso: slim simplified torso with readable clothing
character.arms: thin clearly drawn limbs with a small consistent illustrated width and natural bends
character.legs: thin clearly drawn limbs with a small consistent illustrated width and natural bends
character.clothing: simple graphic clothing that follows the Stickman body without realistic anatomy
character.hair: simple flat hair/accessory cue when useful

characterPresence.rule: use people only when behavior, reaction or social relation is the clearest explanation

moodEngine.rule: each topic may create a brighter, darker, cooler, warmer or more open local world while the hand-drawn Stickman illustration language stays constant

world.rule: characters, props and environments share one simplified illustrated 2D language
world.depth: clear depth by scale, overlap and perspective when useful
world.lighting: illustrated light chosen for the beat, not photorealistic rendering

rules: do not force one red/dark world across all videos
do not force one teal/cream world across all videos
bright topics may be bright and open
dark or power topics may use deeper values and stronger shadows
local environment colors remain believable inside the illustrated world

hardFails: mixed realistic environment and doodle-character rendering
abstract psychology instruction replacing observable evidence
multiple scene numbers combined into one asset
